ground_truth.title: [H-04] Oracle price can be manipulated
ground_truth.description: MagicLpAggregator.latestAnswer() calculates the MagicLP token price from pool reserves. Because those reserve values can be manipulated, an attacker can use a flash loan to inflate the MagicLP oracle price.
ground_truth.impact: A flash-loan-funded swap can substantially inflate the MagicLP oracle valuation within one transaction.
ground_truth.mitigation: Before using pool reserves, compare the pool's base/quote price with the Chainlink-derived base/quote price and revert when the deviation exceeds a defined limit.

ground_truth.title: [H-01] Anyone making use of the MagicLP's TWAP to determine token prices will be exploitable.
ground_truth.description: Because _twapUpdate() runs after the reserves change, an attacker can make the TWAP accumulator attribute the entire elapsed interval to the manipulated post-update price. An integrating application that later reads the TWAP may therefore receive an attacker-controlled price.
ground_truth.impact: Applications that use MagicLP's TWAP to determine token prices can execute trades or other price-dependent operations at an attacker-controlled price, allowing value to be extracted from the integrating application.
